# TaizerCodeCrafter

> High-Performance Web Applications, Custom AI Chatbots, Full-Stack Architecture, and Educational Tech Articles by Supun Dilshan.

## Overview
TaizerCodeCrafter is a professional software engineering portfolio, web development agency, and technology publication platform founded by Supun Dilshan. We build modern, accessible, and high-converting web applications, integrate custom LLM chatbots (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude), and provide comprehensive web development tutorials.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Full Stack Web Development**: Modern responsive applications built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind/CSS.
- **Custom AI Chatbots & LLMs**: Intelligent conversational bots, automated workflows, and contextual business tools.
- **Performance & SEO Optimization**: Lightning-fast loading speeds, mobile-first responsiveness, and search engine visibility.
- **Website Packages & Pricing**: Transparent fixed-price packages ranging from single-page portfolios to enterprise SaaS platforms.

- [Home](https://taizercodecrafter.com/): Official portfolio, services overview, client testimonials, and featured work.
- [Articles & Guides](https://taizercodecrafter.com/articles): Tech tutorials, web development best practices, AI guides, and coding insights.
- [Projects](https://taizercodecrafter.com/projects): Selected production websites, scalable web applications, and open-source projects.
- [Packages & Pricing](https://taizercodecrafter.com/packages): Fixed-price website packages and milestone-based development tiers.
- [Contact & Hire](https://taizercodecrafter.com/contact): Direct project inquiries, consultation scheduling, WhatsApp chat, and quotation requests.
